title: ring_scratch never deleted; claimed temp-arena lifetime contradicts sibling cleanup
evidence:
+	// v2-dublin-board: the attach ring scratch — the board's ring scan fills
+	// it; the per-attempt draw indexes it. Rides the caller's TEMP arena (the
+	// same lifetime as the roster/gview scratch — freed by the frame's
+	// free_all, never owned).
+	ring_scratch: [dynamic]u32
 	defer if gview_ready {
 		group_view_destroy(&gview)
 	}
+	ring: [dynamic]u32
+	defer delete(ring)
detail: ring_scratch grows via context.allocator and is never deleted. Its comment claims temp-arena lifetime like the gview scratch, yet gview is explicitly destroyed and the sibling proc's ring uses defer delete — leaks per spawn window unless the caller's context is temp.
recommended_fix: Add defer delete(ring_scratch) mirroring growth_board_cluster_has_room, or allocate it on the temp arena explicitly; make the comment match the actual ownership.

title: Label collision gap documented as world px but compared in screen px; sizes scale with zoom, gaps don't
evidence:
+// Label-anchor collision gaps (world px) — the preview's at 2× scale, halved
+// for the in-game grid (the baywide's relative density).
+DUBLIN_LABEL_GAP := [6]f32{999, 75, 60, 48, 35, 30}
+		s := dublin_tile_screen(v, d.pos[0], d.pos[1])
+		gap := DUBLIN_LABEL_GAP[ki]
+			dx := s.x - pl[0]
+			dy := s.y - pl[1]
+			if dx * dx + dy * dy < gap * gap {
+		size := max(8, i32(f32(DUBLIN_LABEL_SIZE[ki]) * v.scale))
detail: DUBLIN_LABEL_GAP is documented as world px but compared against screen-space anchor distances (s and placed are to_screen outputs). Label sizes scale with v.scale while gaps do not, so collision behavior changes with zoom — contradicting the stated units.
recommended_fix: Either scale the gap by v.scale for true world-px semantics, or fix the comment to say screen px and document the intentional zoom-dependent collision.

title: Fail-loud loader silently accepts a missing ODbL attribution and silently defaults unknown district kinds
detail: The loader's stated doctrine is fail-loud on any structural violation, yet a missing attribution (the ODbL-required credit) is silently accepted and the renderer silently skips it; likewise an unknown district kind silently defaults to suburb.
recommended_fix: Fail loud on missing attribution and unknown kind with named errors like the other paths; silent acceptance of the legally-required credit undermines the loader's own doctrine.

title: Cluster-level has_room eligibility vs member-level attach draw — the 'defensive' empty-ring continue is routine
detail: Eligibility is per-cluster (some member has room) but the anchor draw is a uniform random member; ring-empty members of eligible clusters make the 'defensive' rng_size<=0 path routine, burning the bounded attempt budget the eligibility check was added to protect.
recommended_fix: Draw the anchor only from members whose ring scan is non-empty (or build the ring over all cluster members' tiles) so eligibility and the draw domain match.

title: Label size/gap tables declared := (mutable package globals) while all sibling art constants use ::
detail: DUBLIN_LABEL_SIZE and DUBLIN_LABEL_GAP are declared with := (mutable package-level variables) while every sibling art constant uses ::. Nothing mutates them; the render package gains unintended mutable global state.
recommended_fix: Change both := declarations to :: constants, matching DUBLIN_STREET_ARTERIAL_W and the other art-tuning constants.

title: Spawn pool and render dots use different grid filters — 'can never disagree' is false at boundaries
detail: The pool filters after rounding while dots filter the raw point: candidates in [-0.5,0) join the pool but not the dots; ones in [w-0.5,w) render but are unspawnable — the 'can never disagree' claim is false at edges.
recommended_fix: Apply one shared filter (filter raw points by their snapped tile) so render dots and the spawn pool cover exactly the same set, or soften the comment.

recommended_fix: Add the teardown call (and unload font_copyright) or correct the comment; the terrain cache (~0.8 MB) and the glyph atlas otherwise leak at exit.

title: PR body committed to the repo root as _pr_body_dublin_board.md
evidence:
diff --git a/_pr_body_dublin_board.md b/_pr_body_dublin_board.md
new file mode 100644
detail: _pr_body_dublin_board.md is committed to the repository root. It is process metadata (a PR description), unreferenced by README or docs — repo pollution that will drift out of sync with the actual PR.
recommended_fix: Remove the file from the tree; keep the PR body in the PR. If durable design notes are wanted, move the rationale into docs/.

title: Vacuous `if step > 0` guard in dublin_map_draw grid — step always positive and unused in the body
detail: step is computed only for `if step > 0`, always true in a live view, and never used inside the block (the loops recompute the spacing inline). Vacuous guard; looks like the leftover of a removed density check.
recommended_fix: Delete step and the guard, or implement the intended density check (skip grid lines when step falls below a pixel threshold).

title: Label off-screen cull uses fixed +/-80px anchor margin; zoomed labels pop at the playfield edge
detail: The cull tests the anchor against a fixed ±80px margin; zoomed labels (size ~57px, several characters wide, drawn centered) extend far beyond 80px horizontally, so they pop in/out at the playfield edge while panning.
recommended_fix: Cull on the label's measured rect (anchor ± half the MeasureTextEx width/height) instead of a constant margin.
